name: ui-consumes-sdk-module
description: UI consuming an SDK module: list the specific files in src/ui/tsconfig.app.json include (like ../core/wire.ts), never the whole ../client dir — config-file.ts imports node:fs and breaks the DOM-lib composite build. Keep the SDK module's transitive closure on src/core/* only (ndjson.ts types its envelope against core/wire.ts ErrorEnvelope, not client/types.ts).

content: Renames must update: (1) src/ui-tests which read page files by name string (capability-layer.test.ts, lifecycle-poll-fallback.test.ts, ready-plans-tab.test.ts, plot-surface-removed.test.ts), and (2) the noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity override in biome.jsonc, which is keyed by path. Component identifiers stay PascalCase; only filenames change.

title: UI revamp planned as pl-7e38: Direction C operator console
rationale: Shell-first in-place rebuild beats a greenfield second UI package (bundle ratchet and dead-code guards would fight a parallel tree) and beats a token reskin (Direction C changes the IA). Forward-chained DAG keeps independent pages dispatchable while component-reuse pairs stay sequential.

name: direction-c-token-wiring
description: Direction C theming (warren-059a): tokens.css holds the verbatim canvas :root (dark base + --color-lt-* twins, fonts given fallback stacks), a :root[data-theme=light] remap plus a prefers-color-scheme no-attribute fallback, a compat layer aliasing legacy names (--color-fg/--color-card/--color-muted-foreground/-foreground inks) onto Direction C base names, and a @theme inline block (self-referencing var() entries are safe in inline mode — utilities get the var(), :root stays the single runtime source). Existing pages use only -(--color-*) arbitrary utilities, so no named color utilities needed re-mapping.

name: direction-c-console-shell
description: Direction C console shell lives in src/ui/src/components/console/ (shell, sidebar, topbar, nav defs, useConsoleStats). Sidebar counts bind to shared list query keys (['runs'], ['projects'], ['agents']) so the lifecycle stream invalidation refreshes them; BURN/RUNTIME figures stay '—' placeholders until the ops overview API (warren-d850). Page stubs use ComingPage naming the building issue. Structural guards in src/ui-tests/capability-layer.test.ts read source files by path — update them when moving components (warren-4ed7).

name: ui-revamp-page-rebuild
description: Direction C page rebuild pattern (warren-e228): source-regex guards in src/ui-tests/capability-layer.test.ts pin exact JSX shapes of pages — when a page redesign renames a component (AddProjectForm -> AddProjectDialog) update the test regexes in the same change; keep OperatorOnly admin-wrapping of RefreshProjectsCTA literal to satisfy the caller-gated-leaf guard.

name: direction-c-page-translation
description: Direction C pages translate Paper exports (docs/ui-revamp/screens/*.jsx) into Tailwind arbitrary-value classes like text-(--color-text-3)/bg-(--color-primary) so both themes come from tokens.css; login page (warren-9297) is the reference for a rebuilt page, incl. gating spectator affordances on GET /instance authMode instead of guessing

name: instance-facts-page-binding
description: Direction C Instance page binds GET /instance via metaApi.instance; the spectator (public auth) response omits operator-only fields (dbBackend, uptimeSeconds, admission), so pages treat them optional and render quiet '—' placeholders. Instance wire types live in src/ui/src/api/instance-types.ts because api/types.ts is at its frozen 776-line size budget.
